title: Quaint Salt Baked Vietnamese Fish Claypot
description: A sour and molten Vietnamese dish featuring soured cream and chive dip, salt-bake, and served in a claypot, this recipe is diabetic-friendly and offers a nostalgic taste of Vietnam.
instructions: Preheat the claypot by filling it with hot water and letting it sit for 10 minutes.
Drain the water from the claypot and add a layer of salt at the bottom.
Place the catfish fillets on top of the salt layer.
Add the bruised lemongrass and kaffir lime leaves on top of the fish.
In a bowl, mix the soured cream, chopped chives, fish sauce, brown sugar, and black pepper.
Pour the cream mixture over the fish and lemongrass.
Cover the claypot with a lid and bake in a preheated oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the claypot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the fish and cream mixture hot, garnished with additional chopped chives if desired.
